_comment: modifiers[].target is one of: stat, skill, allSkills, resource, special. type is flat or percent. Add new traits by copying the shape of an existing one.

positive.name: Strong Mind
positive.description: A disciplined, resilient psyche that resists manipulation and mental strain.

positive.name: Quick Reflexes
positive.description: Reacts a half-step before everyone else in the room.

positive.name: Lucky
positive.description: Fortune leans this character's way more often than chance allows.

positive.name: Brave
positive.description: Steps toward danger when others step back.

positive.name: Genius
positive.description: Processes problems most people would need hours for in seconds.

positive.name: Agile
positive.description: Light on their feet, hard to pin down.

positive.name: Tough
positive.description: Shrugs off punishment that would drop most people.

positive.name: Calm
positive.description: Reads a room without ever raising their own pulse.

positive.name: Fast Learner
positive.description: Picks up new ground faster than most, session after session.

positive.name: Keen Eyes
positive.description: Notices the detail everyone else walks past.

negative.name: Frail
negative.description: Wounds that would be minor on someone else linger and cut deeper here.

negative.name: Reckless
negative.description: Leaps first, and rarely checks how far down the drop is.

negative.name: Greedy
negative.description: Struggles to hide their interest the moment coin or loot is on the table.

negative.name: Slow
negative.description: A half-beat behind whenever speed matters most.

negative.name: Clumsy
negative.description: Footing and timing betray them at the worst moments.

negative.name: Cowardly
negative.description: The instinct to flee is louder than the instinct to fight.

negative.name: Short Temper
negative.description: Patience runs out long before the conversation is over.

negative.name: Weak Constitution
negative.description: Tires and strains faster than their frame should allow.

negative.name: Forgetful
negative.description: Details slip through the cracks, especially old ones.

negative.name: Overconfident
negative.description: Certain of their own read on people, right up until they are wrong.
